events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on July 26, 1943.

angles.name: Jagger's Enduring Energy
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still commanding stages worldwide! Today we're celebrating the legendary Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched, 'Video Killed The Radio Star' first
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video aired.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, a channel launched that changed music forever. MTV hit our screens, kicking off with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' – the album that defined a generation. What's your standout track from their debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in August 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Imagine being there!

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today, 49 years since we lost The King. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix today, 56 years since his passing. His guitar wizardry remains unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Enduring Charm
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still iconic!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Rock Spirit
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, known as Liam Gallagher, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam G's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! The voice of a generation, still bringing the rock 'n' roll.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971. The album of the same name was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod released by Apple
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'. It became available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listen to music forever with the first iPod. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Marwood Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, 'The Beatles' (commonly known as 'The White Album'), was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the eclectic 'White Album'. A double LP that showcased their incredible range.
